title: erodium cicutarium f. subalbidum
intro: Erodium cicutarium f. subalbidum, commonly known as redstem storksbill, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erodium cicutarium f. subalbidum include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of digestive issues, thanks to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of this plant.
